name: plan-forge-flow
description: A typed .NET 10 four-act plan hardening, implementation, and independent review workflow for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Grill, review, build, and verify a plan
interface.longDescription: Turns an idea into a session-scoped plan, reviews it with fresh native Codex sub-agents, implements it step by step with a persistent builder, and performs a complete final review.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge to harden, review, and implement my plan.
